bio:
Abel is renowned for his exceptional skill in crafting stunning black & gray, trash polka, and lettering tattoos, each piece bearing the hallmark of his meticulous attention to detail. Not only is his work aesthetically impressive, but clients consistently praise the unparalleled professionalism that Abel brings to every session, ensuring a comfortable and trustworthy experience. To witness the artistry and professionalism that Abel offers, it's essential to book in advance and secure your spot with a deposit.
